_comment: Terms in doNotTranslate stay exactly as written in every language. preferred lists terms that must always use the same translation; fill translations.<lang> when a language is added. scripts/check-translations.js uses both lists.

preferred.note: A tool that computes a result; one consistent word site-wide.
Difference between two percentages; never the same word as percent.
Relative change from an old to a new value.
Change with no baseline, divided by the average.
IANA zone; city names come from the tool data.
Fiscal year used by the tax authority.
